Header.Name: resourceInfo
Header.Description: Groups together all information required for the description of language resources; specific to tools/services

Element.name: resourceName
Element.Documentation: The full name by which the resource is known; the element can be repeated for the different language versions using the "lang" attribute to specify the language.

Element.name: description
Element.Documentation: Provides the description of the resource in prose

Element.name: resourceShortName
Element.Documentation: The short form (abbreviation, acronym etc.) used to identify the resource; the element can be repeated for the different language versions using the "lang" attribute to specify the language.

Element.name: url
Element.Documentation: A URL used as homepage of an entity (e.g. of a person, organization, resource etc.) and/or where an entity (e.g. LR, document etc.) is located

Element.name: metaShareId
Element.Documentation: An unambiguous referent to the resource within META-SHARE; it reflects to the unique system id provided automatically by the MetaShare software

Element.name: identifier
Element.Documentation: A reference to the resource like a PID or an internal identifier used by the resource provider

Element.name: availability
Element.Documentation: Specifies the availability status of the resource; restrictionsOfUse can be further used to indicate the specific terms of availability

item.AppInfo: For resources available with no restrictions of use
For resources available but with restrictions of uses imposed by the type of licence
For resources that are not available through META-SHARE
For resources whose availability is still pending

Element.name: availabilityEndDate
Element.Documentation: Specifies the end date of availability of a resource - only for cases where a resource is available for a restricted time period.

Element.name: availabilityStartDate
Element.Documentation: Specifies the start date of availability of a resource - only for cases where a resource is available for a restricted time period.

Element.name: licence
Element.Documentation: The licence of use for the resource; for an overview of licences, please visit: http://www.meta-net.eu/meta-share/licenses

Element.name: restrictionsOfUse
Element.Documentation: The restrictionsOfUse optional element in the metadata is only to be taken as providing brief human readable information on the fact that the LR is provided under a specific set of conditions (i.e. restrictions). These correspond to the most frequently used restrictions imposed by the licensor of the LR (via the specified licence). The proper exposition of all restrictions and possible exceptions is to be found inside the license text. LR depositors should, hence, carefully choose the values of this field to match the licence chosen and users should carefully read that licence before using the LR.

Element.name: distributionAccessMedium
Element.Documentation: Specifies the medium (channel) used for delivery or providing access to the resource

Element.name: downloadLocation
Element.Documentation: Any URL where the resource can be downloaded from

Element.name: executionLocation
Element.Documentation: Any URL where the web service providing access to the resource being described and/or the web service that is being described can be executed

Element.name: fee
Element.Documentation: Specifies the costs that are required to access the resource, a fragment of the resource or to use a tool or service

Element.name: attributionText
Element.Documentation: The text that must be quoted for attribution purposes when using a resource - for cases where a resource is provided with a restriction on attribution

Element.name: userNature
Element.Documentation: Provides the framework for describing the conditions imposed by the nature of the user (for instance, a research use may have different implications depending on this)

item.AppInfo: An article from a journal or magazine
A book with an explicit publisher
A work that is printed and bound, but without a named publisher or sponsoring institution
Technical documentation
A report published by a school or other institution
A Master's thesis
A PhD thesis
A part of a book, which may be a chapter (or section) and/or a range of pages
A part of a book having its own title
The proceedings of a conference
An article in a conference proceedings
A document having an author and title, but not formally published
Use this type when nothing else fits

Element.name: title
Element.Documentation: The title of the document; the element can be repeated for the different language versions using the "lang" attribute to specify the language.

Element.name: author
Element.Documentation: The name(s) of the author(s); for multiple authors, please use "and" in between.

Element.name: editor
Element.Documentation: The name(s) of the editor(s); in case of multiple editors, please use "and" in between

Element.name: year
Element.Documentation: The year of publication or, for an unpublished work, the year it was written

Element.name: publisher
Element.Documentation: The name of the publisher/publishing house

Element.name: bookTitle
Element.Documentation: The title of a book, part of which is being cited

Element.name: journal
Element.Documentation: A journal name; abbreviations could also be provided

Element.name: volume
Element.Documentation: Specifies the volume of a journal or multivolume book

Element.name: series
Element.Documentation: The name of a series or set of books; when citing an entire book, the title field gives its title and an optional series field gives the name of a series or multi-volume set in which the book is published

Element.name: pages
Element.Documentation: One or more page numbers or range of page numbers

Element.name: edition
Element.Documentation: The edition of a book

Element.name: conference
Element.Documentation: The name of the conference in which the document has been presented

Element.name: doi
Element.Documentation: A digital object identifier assigned to the document

Element.name: url
Element.Documentation: A URL used as homepage of an entity (e.g. of a person, organization, resource etc.) and/or where an entity (e.g. LR, document etc.) is located

Element.name: ISSN
Element.Documentation: The International Standard Serial Number used to identify a journal

Element.name: ISBN
Element.Documentation: The International Standard Book Number

Element.name: keywords

Element.name: title
Element.Documentation: The title of the document; the element can be repeated for the different language versions using the "lang" attribute to specify the language.

Element.name: author
Element.Documentation: The name(s) of the author(s); for multiple authors, please use "and" in between.

Element.name: editor
Element.Documentation: The name(s) of the editor(s); in case of multiple editors, please use "and" in between

Element.name: year
Element.Documentation: The year of publication or, for an unpublished work, the year it was written

Element.name: publisher
Element.Documentation: The name of the publisher/publishing house

Element.name: bookTitle
Element.Documentation: The title of a book, part of which is being cited

Element.name: journal
Element.Documentation: A journal name; abbreviations could also be provided

Element.name: volume
Element.Documentation: Specifies the volume of a journal or multivolume book

Element.name: series
Element.Documentation: The name of a series or set of books; when citing an entire book, the title field gives its title and an optional series field gives the name of a series or multi-volume set in which the book is published

Element.name: pages
Element.Documentation: One or more page numbers or range of page numbers

Element.name: edition
Element.Documentation: The edition of a book

Element.name: conference
Element.Documentation: The name of the conference in which the document has been presented

Element.name: doi
Element.Documentation: A digital object identifier assigned to the document

Element.name: url
Element.Documentation: A URL used as homepage of an entity (e.g. of a person, organization, resource etc.) and/or where an entity (e.g. LR, document etc.) is located

Element.name: ISSN
Element.Documentation: The International Standard Serial Number used to identify a journal

Element.name: ISBN
Element.Documentation: The International Standard Book Number

Element.name: keywords
Element.Documentation: The keyword(s) for indexing and classification of the document

Element.name: documentLanguageName
Element.Documentation: The name of the language the document is written in, as mentioned in IETF BCP47; an autocompletion mechanism with values from the ISO 639 is provided in the editor, but the values can be subsequently edited for further specification (according to the IETF BCP47 guidelines)

Element.name: documentLanguageId
Element.Documentation: The id of the language the document is written in; an autocompletion mechanism with values from the ISO 639 is provided in the editor, but the values can be subsequently edited for further specification (according to the IETF BCP47 guidelines)

Element.name: role
Element.Documentation: role of documents

Element.name: documentUnstructured
Element.Documentation: Used either as a free text description or as an unstructured (free form) presentation of a bibliographic record; alternative to the structured presentation of a document (cf. documentInfo)
